CARDS.name: Premier Happy Card (遠東頂級快樂卡)

topics.response: The Premier Happy Card is our flagship premium travel card, aimed at frequent international travelers and high spenders. Headline perks include unlimited airport transfers, unlimited airport lounge access, up to 3% overseas cash back, up to 30 days of free airport parking, and travel insurance up to NT$50 million.
topics.responseZh: 遠東頂級快樂卡是我們的旗艦級頂級旅遊卡,適合經常出國旅遊及高消費的持卡人。主要優惠包括無限次機場接送、無限次機場貴賓室、最高3%海外現金回饋、最高30天免費機場停車,以及最高新台幣5,000萬元的旅遊保險。

topics.response: I don't have the current annual fee for this card confirmed — let me connect you with a representative for the exact amount. There is a renewal cash-back bonus of up to NT$10,000 available for returning cardholders.
topics.responseZh: 目前我無法確認此卡的年費金額,讓我為您轉接客服人員確認正確金額。續卡持卡人另有最高新台幣10,000元的續卡現金回饋。

topics.response: Unlimited free airport transfers are available once you charge a full international airfare or at least 80% of a tour package, for a minimum transaction of NT$20,000, up to 2 uses per trip. Vehicles are Benz or Lexus-class sedans, and bookings need at least 3 business days' notice.
topics.responseZh: 只要您刷卡支付全額國際機票或至少80%的旅遊團費,單筆消費滿新台幣20,000元,即可享無限次免費機場接送,每趟行程最多使用2次。車輛為Benz或Lexus等級房車,需提前至少3個工作天預約。

topics.response: You get unlimited worldwide airport lounge visits through Priority Pass or U.FIRST, once you charge a full international airfare or at least 80% of a tour package, up to 2 visits per trip. If you don't meet the spending threshold, exceed the 2-visit limit, or bring a guest, the bank charges US$27 per person per use, billed to the following month's statement. Membership itself is free to apply for by calling customer service, and the physical card arrives within 7 business days, valid for 1 year.
topics.responseZh: 只要您刷卡支付全額國際機票或至少80%的旅遊團費,即可透過Priority Pass或U.FIRST無限次使用全球機場貴賓室,每趟行程最多2次。若未達消費門檻、超過2次使用限制,或有陪同賓客,銀行將於次月帳單按每人每次收取US$27。會員卡申請免費,致電客服即可申請,約7個工作天內寄出實體卡,有效期1年。

topics.response: Overseas spending earns up to 3% cash back across three stackable, monthly-registered tiers, capped at NT$9,000 per household per month for the base tier, with additional quarterly and regional bonuses.
topics.responseZh: 海外消費最高可享3%現金回饋,分三個可疊加、需每月登錄的級距,基本級距每戶每月上限新台幣9,000元,另有季度及地區加碼回饋。

topics.response: You get up to 30 free parking days per airport location once you charge a full airfare, 80% of a tour package, or NT$25,000 or more in general spending within the prior two months.
topics.responseZh: 只要您刷卡支付全額機票、80%旅遊團費,或近兩個月一般消費滿新台幣25,000元,即可享每個機場據點最高30天免費停車。

topics.response: Coverage runs up to NT$50 million for the cardholder and eligible dependents, when the full public-transport fare or at least 80% of a tour package is charged to the card.
topics.responseZh: 只要刷卡支付全額大眾運輸票款或至少80%旅遊團費,持卡人及符合資格的家屬最高可享新台幣5,000萬元保障。

topics.response: You also get Far Eastern Department Store and City'super shopping privileges, Shangri-La dining perks, golf course offers, free downtown parking, and roadside assistance. HAPPY GO points don't expire while the card is active.
topics.responseZh: 此外還享有遠東百貨及City'super購物優惠、香格里拉餐飲禮遇、高爾夫球場優惠、市區免費停車,以及道路救援服務。卡片有效期間內,HAPPY GO點數不會過期。

topics.response: The Happy Card is our everyday cash-back card, built around daily spending categories like department stores, supermarkets, clothing, cosmetics, online shopping, and LINE Pay.
topics.responseZh: 遠東快樂信用卡是我們的日常現金回饋卡,聚焦於百貨公司、超市、服飾、美妝、網路購物及LINE Pay等日常消費類別。

topics.response: I don't have the current annual fee for this card confirmed — let me connect you with a representative for the exact amount.
topics.responseZh: 目前我無法確認此卡的年費金額,讓我為您轉接客服人員確認正確金額。

topics.response: You can earn up to 5% cash back on daily spending categories including LINE Pay, capped at NT$300 per household per month with monthly registration required, plus a separate bonus once monthly spending reaches NT$15,000.
topics.responseZh: 日常消費類別(含LINE Pay)最高可享5%現金回饋,每戶每月上限新台幣300元,需每月登錄;另外當月消費滿新台幣15,000元還有額外回饋。

topics.response: At SOGO you can earn up to 2x HAPPY GO points, plus 3x on cosmetics purchases of NT$3,000 or more. Far Eastern Department Store offers up to 9% off plus free parking, and several partner restaurants offer 15 to 18% off.
topics.responseZh: 於SOGO消費最高可享2倍HAPPY GO點數,美妝品消費滿新台幣3,000元以上可享3倍點數。遠東百貨最高享9%折扣並附贈免費停車,多家合作餐廳可享15%至18%折扣。

topics.response: The standard tier earns 3% cash back on overseas spending, capped at NT$9,000 a month, with monthly registration required, plus a regional bonus for Japan, Korea, Singapore, Thailand, or the USA.
topics.responseZh: 基本級距海外消費可享3%現金回饋,每月上限新台幣9,000元,需每月登錄;於日本、韓國、新加坡、泰國或美國消費另有地區加碼回饋。

topics.response: Coverage runs up to NT$20 million total when the full public transport fare or 80% or more of a tour package is charged to the card.
topics.responseZh: 只要刷卡支付全額大眾運輸票款或80%以上旅遊團費,總保障最高可達新台幣2,000萬元。

topics.response: EasyCard auto-reload earns 5% cash back, High-Speed Rail and Taiwan Rail spending earns 3% once monthly spending hits NT$3,000, and there are eTag and private-parking benefits as well.
topics.responseZh: 悠遊卡自動加值可享5%現金回饋,高鐵及台鐵消費當月滿新台幣3,000元可享3%回饋,另有eTag及特約停車場優惠。

CARDS.name: World Card / Infinity Card (世界卡/無限卡)

topics.response: The World Card and Infinity Card are a premium Far Eastern Department Store Group co-branded travel and rewards card pairing, with most benefits shared between the two variants.
topics.responseZh: 世界卡與無限卡是遠東百貨集團聯名的頂級旅遊回饋卡系列,兩種卡別的優惠大多相通。

topics.response: The primary cardholder pays NT$10,000 a year; supplementary cards are free. It's waived the first year, and waived again in later years if annual spending reaches NT$300,000 or more.
topics.responseZh: 正卡持卡人年費為新台幣10,000元,附卡免年費。首年免年費,之後年度消費滿新台幣300,000元以上可再次免年費。

topics.response: You earn 1 HAPPY GO point per NT$100 spent, up to 2 points at partner merchants, and points from general spending don't expire.
topics.responseZh: 每消費新台幣100元可得1點HAPPY GO點數,於合作商家最高可得2點,一般消費所得點數不會過期。

topics.response: Dining perks include a 'two diners, one free' offer at Far Eastern Shangri-La cafés, and 10 to 20% off at several partner restaurants.
topics.responseZh: 餐飲優惠包括遠東香格里拉咖啡廳「兩人同行一人免費」,以及多家合作餐廳10%至20%折扣。

topics.response: Spending NT$30,000 or more in a month earns one free weekday golf round the following month, and NT$60,000 or more earns two rounds, at select courses.
topics.responseZh: 當月消費滿新台幣30,000元,次月可享1場平日免費高爾夫球局;滿新台幣60,000元可享2場,限指定球場。

topics.response: International travel insurance covers medical and emergency evacuation up to NT$3.19 million, with hospital daily allowances and COVID-19 quarantine costs also covered, for trips registered before departure.
topics.responseZh: 國際旅遊保險最高保障新台幣319萬元的醫療與緊急救援費用,並涵蓋住院日額與COVID-19隔離費用,需於出發前完成登錄。

topics.response: You get Priority Pass or U.FIRST lounge access, 4 uses per period (primary and supplementary combined), once any of your prior 3 monthly statements shows NT$10,000 or more in general spending. If you don't meet that threshold, exceed the 4-use limit, or bring a guest, the bank charges US$27 per person per use, billed to the following month's statement. Apply by calling customer service; the card is mailed within 7 business days and is valid for 1 year.
topics.responseZh: 只要近3期任一帳單一般消費滿新台幣10,000元,即可享Priority Pass或U.FIRST機場貴賓室,每期可使用4次(正卡及附卡合計)。若未達消費門檻、超過4次使用限制,或有陪同賓客,銀行將於次月帳單按每人每次收取US$27。致電客服即可申請,約7個工作天內寄出卡片,有效期1年。

topics.response: Free airport transfers are available on several routes, with a bonus of 2 additional free transfers once cumulative annual spending reaches NT$180,000.
topics.responseZh: 多條路線提供免費機場接送,累計年度消費滿新台幣180,000元可再享2趟加碼免費接送。

topics.response: Overseas spending earns 1.5% base cash back plus an extra 1% for Japan, Korea, Singapore, Thailand, or the USA once monthly spending there hits NT$60,000 — up to 2.5% total.
topics.responseZh: 海外消費基本可享1.5%現金回饋,於日本、韓國、新加坡、泰國或美國當月消費滿新台幣60,000元,再加碼1%,合計最高2.5%。

topics.response: The LeXing Card is a mid-tier card for frequent travelers and commuters, organized around lifestyle rewards, transportation, and shopping benefits.
topics.responseZh: 遠東樂行卡是為經常旅遊及通勤族設計的中階卡片,主打生活回饋、交通及購物三大優惠面向。

topics.response: It's NT$2,000 a year for the primary cardholder, with supplementary cards free — waived the first year, and waived again if annual spending reaches NT$60,000 or more, or you make 12 or more transactions in the year.
topics.responseZh: 正卡持卡人年費為新台幣2,000元,附卡免年費。首年免年費,之後年度消費滿新台幣60,000元以上或年度交易滿12筆可再次免年費。

topics.response: You get uncapped 1% cash back on domestic spending, 2% on overseas spending, and 1 HAPPY GO point per NT$100 spent, once monthly statement spending reaches NT$3,000.
topics.responseZh: 國內消費享無上限1%現金回饋,海外消費2%,當月帳單消費滿新台幣3,000元,每消費新台幣100元可得1點HAPPY GO點數。

topics.response: Up to 3% cash back applies to fuel, EasyCard auto-reload, taxis, e-scooters and bikes, airline tickets, and travel booking sites, capped at NT$300 per household per month.
topics.responseZh: 加油、悠遊卡自動加值、計程車、電動機車與單車、機票及訂票網站消費最高享3%現金回饋,每戶每月上限新台幣300元。

topics.response: Auto maintenance earns up to 2% cash back quarterly, insurance premiums earn up to 3.5% cash back or 0% installments, and designated tax payments earn up to 0.5% cash back.
topics.responseZh: 汽車保養每季最高享2%現金回饋,保險費最高享3.5%現金回饋或0%分期,指定稅款最高享0.5%現金回饋。

topics.response: You get free parking once monthly spending hits NT$15,000, a free monthly car wash once spending hits NT$8,000, and two free 50-kilometer roadside tows once NT$20,000 has been spent in any of the prior 3 statements.
topics.responseZh: 當月消費滿新台幣15,000元享免費停車,滿新台幣8,000元每月享1次免費洗車,近3期任一帳單消費滿新台幣20,000元可享2次50公里免費道路救援拖吊。

topics.response: Far Eastern Department Store offers up to 9% off plus free parking hours, and City'super offers 5% off.
topics.responseZh: 遠東百貨最高享9%折扣並附贈免費停車時數,City'super享95折優惠。

topics.response: The eTag Card is a co-branded card built around driving, tolls, and parking.
topics.responseZh: eTag聯名卡是圍繞行車、通行費與停車優惠設計的聯名卡片。

topics.response: I don't have the current annual fee for this card confirmed — let me connect you with a representative for the exact amount.
topics.responseZh: 目前我無法確認此卡的年費金額,讓我為您轉接客服人員確認正確金額。

topics.response: Free eTag smart parking gives you 5 uses a month, once daily, 2 hours per session, once monthly general spending hits NT$15,000, with a separate benefit at partner private parking lots.
topics.responseZh: 當月一般消費滿新台幣15,000元,可享eTag智慧停車每月5次免費使用,每日1次、每次2小時,特約民營停車場另有獨立優惠。

topics.response: You get up to 7 free days per session at Taoyuan or Kaohsiung airport, 2 sessions per airport, once you charge a full international ticket, 80% of a tour package, or NT$25,000 or more in general spending.
topics.responseZh: 只要刷卡支付全額國際機票、80%旅遊團費,或一般消費滿新台幣25,000元,即可於桃園或高雄機場享每次最高7天免費停車,每機場2次。

topics.response: Every NT$400 of successful eTag auto-reload or smart-parking fees paid earns 1 eTag POINT, worth NT$1, redeemable against parking fees or converted to eTag stored value.
topics.responseZh: 每成功儲值eTag或繳納智慧停車費滿新台幣400元,可得1點eTag POINT,每點折抵新台幣1元,可折抵停車費或轉換為eTag儲值金。

topics.response: Far Eastern Department Store offers up to 10% off plus free parking hours, and Taipei 101 offers free parking hours with qualifying same-day spending.
topics.responseZh: 遠東百貨最高享9折優惠並附贈免費停車時數,台北101於當日達指定消費金額可享免費停車時數。

topics.response: The Happy+ Family Card is marketed as our first credit card focused on parent-child benefits, covering cash back, family perks, domestic shopping, travel, and financial-product perks.
topics.responseZh: 遠東樂家＋卡是我們首張以親子優惠為主打的信用卡,涵蓋現金回饋、家庭禮遇、國內購物、旅遊及金融商品優惠。

topics.response: I don't have the current annual fee or waiver conditions for this card confirmed — let me connect you with a representative for the exact details.
topics.responseZh: 目前我無法確認此卡的年費金額或免年費條件,讓我為您轉接客服人員確認詳細內容。

topics.response: Once monthly new spending reaches NT$26,000, the primary cardholder can register for either a NT$400 cash credit or a free beauty course, posted as a statement credit by the end of the following month.
topics.responseZh: 當月新增消費滿新台幣26,000元,正卡持卡人可登錄選擇新台幣400元現金回饋或免費美容課程,於次月底前以帳單折抵入帳。

topics.response: Spending at designated children's-floor counters at Far Eastern Chengcheng Mall earns 4x points, plus an extra 2x posted to your HAPPY GO account each billing cycle.
topics.responseZh: 於遠東誠品成功店指定兒童樓層櫃位消費可享4倍點數,並於每期帳單另加碼2倍點數存入HAPPY GO帳戶。

topics.response: You can pay tuition through our i-payment platform and apply for 3 interest-free installment periods at 0% fees before the current billing cycle closes.
topics.responseZh: 您可透過i-payment繳費平台繳交學費,並於當期帳單結帳日前申請3期0%利率的免息分期。

CARDS.name: Happy Unlimited Card / Happy World Business Card (遠東快樂無限卡/快樂世界商務卡)

topics.response: The Happy Unlimited Card and Happy World Business Card are a premium travel and business card pairing, built around uncapped foreign-currency cash back, HAPPY GO rewards on domestic spending, and airport travel perks.
topics.responseZh: 遠東快樂無限卡與快樂世界商務卡是主打海外消費無上限現金回饋、國內消費HAPPY GO回饋,以及機場旅遊禮遇的頂級旅遊商務卡系列。

topics.response: The primary cardholder pays NT$10,000 a year, waived the first year; supplementary cards are free. It's waived again in later years once annual spending reaches NT$300,000 or more, or with 6 or more VIP stars and auto-pay enrollment.
topics.responseZh: 正卡持卡人年費為新台幣10,000元,首年免年費,附卡免年費。之後年度消費滿新台幣300,000元以上,或達6星以上VIP等級並加入自動扣繳,可再次免年費。

topics.response: Overseas spending earns 2.5% uncapped cash back, plus an extra 1% for Japan, Korea, Singapore, Thailand, or the USA once monthly spending there exceeds NT$60,000 — up to 5% total.
topics.responseZh: 海外消費可享2.5%無上限現金回饋,於日本、韓國、新加坡、泰國或美國當月消費超過新台幣60,000元,再加碼1%,合計最高5%。

topics.response: Domestic spending earns 1 HAPPY GO point per NT$100 spent, plus a monthly cash-back bonus once spending reaches NT$20,000, up to NT$1,000-1,500 a month depending on your account tier.
topics.responseZh: 國內每消費新台幣100元可得1點HAPPY GO點數,當月消費滿新台幣20,000元另享現金回饋,依帳戶等級每月最高新台幣1,000至1,500元。

topics.response: You get up to 4 free airport transfers a year once your spending in the prior 12 months reaches NT$800,000 to NT$1,200,000, depending on your account tier.
topics.responseZh: 近12個月消費依帳戶等級達新台幣800,000至1,200,000元,即可享每年最高4次免費機場接送。

topics.response: You get up to 4 free airport lounge visits per 6-month period, once your recent spending reaches NT$10,000 or more.
topics.responseZh: 近期消費滿新台幣10,000元以上,即可享每半年最高4次免費機場貴賓室。

topics.response: You get up to 30 free parking days at Taoyuan or Kaohsiung airport once you charge NT$25,000 or more toward an airfare purchase.
topics.responseZh: 刷卡購買機票消費滿新台幣25,000元以上,即可享桃園或高雄機場最高30天免費停車。

topics.response: Travel accident insurance covers up to NT$35 million; the Mastercard variant also includes medical coverage up to NT$3.19 million.
topics.responseZh: 旅遊平安保險最高保障新台幣3,500萬元;萬事達卡版本另享最高新台幣319萬元的醫療保障。

topics.response: Far Eastern Department Store offers up to 9% off, select luxury hotel buffets offer a buy-one-get-one-free deal up to 24 times a month, partner restaurants offer 5% off, and golf club rates start from NT$3,230.
topics.responseZh: 遠東百貨最高享9%折扣,指定五星級飯店自助餐每月最高24次買一送一,合作餐廳享95折優惠,高爾夫球場優惠價格自新台幣3,230元起。

CARDS.name: HAPPY GO Premium Card (遠東HAPPY GO頂級卡)

topics.response: The HAPPY GO Premium Card is a premium rewards card built around HAPPY GO points, overseas cash back, airport travel perks, and Shangri-La hotel and dining privileges.
topics.responseZh: 遠東HAPPY GO頂級卡是主打HAPPY GO點數、海外現金回饋、機場旅遊禮遇,以及香格里拉飯店與餐飲優惠的頂級回饋卡。

topics.response: The standard plan is NT$12,000 a year with a NT$20,000 value voucher package rebate; the premium plan is NT$15,000 with a NT$25,000 rebate but requires a supplementary card application. Supplementary cards themselves have a lifetime fee waiver.
topics.responseZh: 標準方案年費新台幣12,000元,並回饋新台幣20,000元等值禮遇package;頂級方案年費新台幣15,000元,回饋新台幣25,000元等值package,但須同時申辦附卡。附卡本身終身免年費。

topics.response: You earn 1 HAPPY GO point per NT$100 spent, up to 2 points at partner merchants, and points don't expire.
topics.responseZh: 每消費新台幣100元可得1點HAPPY GO點數,於合作商家最高可得2點,點數不會過期。

topics.response: Spending in Japan, Korea, Singapore, Thailand, or the USA earns up to 1% cash back once monthly spending there reaches NT$60,000 or more.
topics.responseZh: 於日本、韓國、新加坡、泰國或美國消費,當月消費滿新台幣60,000元以上,最高可享1%現金回饋。

topics.response: You get 4 free Priority Pass or U.FIRST airport lounge visits a year, once you've spent NT$10,000 or more in the prior 3 months.
topics.responseZh: 近3個月消費滿新台幣10,000元以上,即可享每年4次免費Priority Pass或U.FIRST機場貴賓室。

topics.response: You get up to 30 free parking days at Taoyuan and 30 at Kaohsiung airport when you purchase a full-price ticket or tour package over NT$25,000.
